source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway – General Construction (Coastal Steel)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement for general construction at Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway. Contractor: Coastal Steel Inc. (steel specialist; previously worked on the Chinese Theatre façade of the attraction). Filed by Disney’s Facility Asset Management team, typically associated with maintenance rather than major thematic changes. No closure announced.
permits.location: Disney's Hollywood Studios – Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway

permits.title: Indiana Jones / Tropical Americas – General Construction extension (Ferran Services)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement for general construction at the future Indiana Jones ride (former DINOSAUR) in Tropical Americas. Contractor: Ferran Services & Contracting, Inc. (HVAC, electrical, plumbing specialist). Filed by Disney’s Facility Asset Management. Extension of an earlier permit; new expiration April 30, 2027.
permits.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Tropical Americas / Indiana Jones

permits.title: Mysterious new Monstropolis permit (Hollywood Studios)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a new permit related to the developing Monstropolis land (former Muppets Courtyard area). Official document link not yet located in public reporting.

permits.title: Five new general construction permits at Disney resorts
permits.description: Disney filed five new permits covering general construction work across multiple resorts. Individual official document links not yet extracted.

permits.title: Infrastructure & System Enhancements — Indiana Jones / DINOSAUR area
permits.description: “General Construction and Building Infrastructure and System Enhancements.” Filed for the DINOSAUR attraction address as part of the Tropical Americas retheme. Contractor: Balfour Beatty.
permits.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Tropical Americas / DINOSAUR

permits.title: Germany Pavilion – General Construction / Roof Refurbishment (EPCOT)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement for general construction at the Germany Pavilion (address associated with 1750 Avenue of the Stars). Contractor: MSG Legacy, Inc. d/b/a RSS Roofing Services & Solutions Florida. Filed by Disney Facility Asset Management. Amended filing valid through January 29, 2027. Consistent with ongoing exterior/roof work around Stein Haus.
permits.contractor: MSG Legacy, Inc. (RSS Roofing Services & Solutions)

permits.title: Typhoon Lagoon Backstage Parking Lot
permits.description: New roadway leading to a fenced-in backstage gravel parking lot behind Crush ’n’ Gusher. Includes stormwater management with two dry retention ponds and four conveyance swales. SFWMD filing.

permits.title: Electrical permit — Glob Theater (Monstropolis)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement for electrical work at the former Muppet*Vision 3D building (now Glob Theater). Contractor: Elite A/V Systems Inc.
permits.location: Disney's Hollywood Studios – Glob Theater / Monstropolis
